title: Plug-in compatibility: FileMaker Server
description: Plug-in function calls in scope that do not run on FileMaker Server: MBS functions whose documentation marks Server=No (verbatim platform flags from the MBS docs mirror, interpreted onto this environment via the curated runtime map - scripts here execute under the FileMaker Server script engine). Includes one-level custom-function wrappers (via_custom_function) and layout/field calculation usages (evidence_kind='layout'). Functions of a known plugin without a doc entry appear as explicit 'unresolved' info rows. Server x OS cross-refinement: functions available on the server but not on every server operating system (practically: not for Linux) surface as 'warning' with finding_kind='os_conditional' and the carrying OS set in os_condition - they run on macOS/Windows servers but fail on Linux-based FileMaker Server (the host matrix comes from the curated FileMaker reference schema; on an older reference the member is skipped, never failed).
author: fm-lab rules

rule.rationale: Plug-in functions whose MBS documentation marks Server=No are unavailable under the FileMaker Server script engine, which executes scripts for this environment. The mapping is a curated interpretation with per-row provenance (plugin_runtime_map).
rule.remediation: Guard or replace the call for this runtime (e.g. branch on Get(Device)/execution context, or move the interactive part to a client script). Unresolved functions: update the MBS docs mirror (install-mbs-docs) and re-derive the plugin platform map.

defaultResult.name: finding_count
defaultResult.meaning: Plug-in function calls in scope that do not run on FileMaker Server
